why: This is an education-specific analytic typology for classifying technology-mediated work-integrated-learning experiences, not a general explanatory theory of learning.
name: Two-dimensional typology of eWIL: function of technology by degree of technological involvement

why: EWIMS is a named school-based intervention and monitoring programme rather than a general instructional element.
name: Early Warning Intervention and Monitoring System (EWIMS)
product_description: A school-based early-warning and intervention programme developed for identifying students at risk of not graduating on time, matching them with supports, and monitoring their progress.

why: The Electronic Works Achievement Test is a named, researcher-developed assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Electronic Works Achievement Test (EWAT)
product_description: A 30-item multiple-choice achievement test developed by Ogbuanya et al. to measure technical-college students’ learning of Electronic Devices and Circuits in Electronic Works.

why: This is a study-specific measurement instrument used to collect end-of-session perceptions of TBL management, participation, and satisfaction, rather than a reusable instructional feedback practice.
name: Ewha TBL end-of-session feedback questionnaire
product_description: A four-point end-of-session questionnaire developed by the Ewha Womans University College of Medicine TBL Board to gather medical students’ perceptions of TBL session management, participation, and satisfaction.
